title: Tech Note: Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D's native pivot table and pivot chart objects introduced around v16 remain part of the product line and continue to be usable; later 4D versions have refined listbox/chart capabilities further, and equivalent business-intelligence-style reporting can also now be built with 4D Write Pro or exported data fed into external BI tools.
